subject: Lifeline AI pilot — request for extra credits + trial extension
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@lifeline.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lifeline.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Lifeline AI pilot — request for extra credits + trial extension

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for getting the Lifeline AI team up and running on Redwood last week — the integration went smoothly and we've started running a small e2e evaluation. Early signal looks promising but we burned through our initial pilot credits faster than we expected (a lot of long-context generation on fine-tuned streams).

Two asks from our side so we can finish a full product validation by mid-September:
- Top up pilot credits by 250k tokens (we can provide a usage breakdown).
- Extend the 30-day trial window by 21 days so we can complete the second round of customer-facing prompts.

We understand this is an exception request; happy to accept a short-term commit if that helps (we're targeting a paid subscription decision by Oct). Would you be able to route this for exec consideration?

I've attached the current SOW (v2) and a CSV with token burn by test-suite.

Thanks,
Liam

--
Liam O'Connell
Head of Product, Lifeline AI
liam.oconnell@lifeline.ai
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@lifeline.ai>, procurement@lifeline.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Lifeline AI pilot — request for extra credits + trial extension

Aditya / Marissa,

Forwarding a request from Lifeline AI (attached SOW + usage). Quick context: live POC started 8/24, they're seeing heavy token consumption due to batch generation for web demo workflows. They committed to an evaluation and have clear go/no-go timeline (decision by early Oct).

Proposed concession (what sales proposes):
- 250k token credit top-up for the pilot (one-time, non-recurring).
- 21-day trial extension (new last day would be 9/21).
- Ask for a soft commit: Lifeline will provide a short note of intent to evaluate paid tier (no legal binding).

Reason this matters: Lifeline is a healthcare-adjacent startup with a small engineering org but strong product fit; if they pass evaluation, expected initial ARR ~ $45k ARR and runway to expand in Q1. We can get a signed SOW if we offer the top-up.

Risks: token top-up is small relative to typical concessions, but we should confirm no chargebacks & ensure clear end date. Finance flagged earlier that we should avoid automatic conversion to paid credits without agreement.

Marissa — can you review the concession and confirm E2E billing/GAAP treatment? Aditya — request exec sign-off for the one-time concession and extension. I've included the HubSpot deal and proposed DocuSign flow in related links.

Attachments: Lifeline_SOW_v2.pdf, pilot-usage-summary-aug.csv

Thanks,
Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@lifeline.ai>, procurement@lifeline.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lifeline AI pilot — request for extra credits + trial extension

Priya / Marissa — reviewed the usage and ask. Approve the concession with the following conditions:

1) 250k token credit issued as promo credit tied to deal ID DEAL-2026-LIF-1029, expires 2026-10-15. No cash refund or carryover.
2) 21-day trial extension (new end date 2026-09-21). Engineering to lock demo quota and disable auto-regen beyond 21 days.
3) Lifeline signs a short acknowledgment (one-paragraph) confirming evaluation intent and agreeing to trial end terms; DocuSign link to be sent by Priya.
4) Finance will mark this as a marketing/promotional concession (no revenue recognition impact). Marissa, please confirm accounting code (fine if it's promo_credit_2026-Q3).

Marissa — once you confirm finance tagging, Priya can send the DocuSign and we can push credits. I'll ask ops to run the credit grant after DocuSign executed.

Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
VP, Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lifeline AI pilot — request for extra credits + trial extension

Liam — good news. Aditya approved the one-time concession. Next steps:

1) I'll send a one-page acknowledgment via DocuSign (link included). Please sign and return; that will trigger the credit grant.
2) Once DocuSign returns, Ops will apply the 250k token promo credit scoped to DEAL-2026-LIF-1029 and with expiration 2026-10-15.
3) Trial extension to 2026-09-21 will be applied immediately after signature.

Link to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/12345-link
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1029

I will notify you as soon as credits are provisioned (usually within 24 hours after signature). Thanks for the clear usage report — that helped speed review.

- Priya
